User.title: User
User.description: User profile with verified OpenID Connect claims, keyed by stable sub identifier

sub.description: Stable OpenID Connect subject identifier (matches request.auth.uid)

emailVerified.description: True if email_verified claim from Google ID token was verified

displayName.description: User's display name from Google profile

role.description: Role in the disaster coordination system (coordinator or volunteer)

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user identity records keyed by unique sub claim identifier
